subject: Request: Staggered invoicing / extended net terms for Orwell Health
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Maya Desai <maya.desai@orwellhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2026 14:07:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed billing cadence for pilot + SOW

Hi Maya,

Thanks for the time today — great alignment on scope for the Q3 pilot. Attached is the draft SOW and a sample billing schedule. Per our standard terms we bill monthly net-30, but I wanted to propose a staggered schedule that better fits your internal procurement cycle: two invoices per quarter (month 1 and month 3) with a net-60 window for each invoice.

High-level:
- Pilot value: Redwood hosted inference (2x r5 GPU) + integration support
- Billing: two invoices per quarter (50% / 50%)
- Terms: Net-60 for each invoice

If procurement needs a different cadence (quarterly invoices or net-90), we can escalate for approval — just flag what you need and I’ll loop in our finance and leadership.

Attachments: SOW_Redwood-Orwell_v1.pdf

Next actions: Can you confirm whether Net-60 (two invoices / quarter) will work, or do you need a single quarterly invoice with Net-90?

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0128

Hi Ben,

Thanks — SOW looks good. Procurement reviewed the schedule and asked whether Orwell can receive a single quarterly invoice instead of two (simpler for our AP), and whether we can push to Net-90 for SaaS line items during the pilot. Our standard policy is quarterly + Net-90 for new vendors during evaluation.

Is that something Redwood can accommodate? If yes, we’ll need an approval memo to attach to our purchase request.

Subject: Fwd: Proposed billing cadence for pilot + SOW — Orwell asking for quarterly net-90

Laura / Marcus —

Looping you in. Orwell is asking for a single quarterly invoice and Net-90 for the pilot. Deal size ~ $185k ARR run-rate for the pilot/initial year (see HubSpot link). Procurement specifically needs an approval memo to attach to their purchase request.

Questions:
- Marcus: finance impact for Net-90 + single quarterly invoice (days sales outstanding, cashflow risk, any recommended mitigations?)
- Laura: sales-side view — can we accept Net-90 for pilot only in exchange for a smaller concession (one-time implementation credit or temporary discount)?

I attached the SOW above. I can also prepare a short memo for leadership if you need routing language.

Ben

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Desai <maya.desai@orwellhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 10:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Proposed billing cadence for pilot + SOW — Orwell asking for quarterly net-90

Ben / Laura,

Finance notes: Net-90 materially increases DSO and working capital pressure for a deal of this size. If leadership is comfortable, we can approve a temporary Net-90 for the 6-month pilot under the following conditions:

1) Redwood requires a processing/financing fee of 2.0% of invoice value to offset extended exposure.
2) Attach signed Finance_MA_Approval_Form.xlsx (I attached a filled template) to the PO.
3) For renewal/production (beyond pilot), terms revert to standard net-30 unless explicitly re-approved.
4) If Orwell prefers a single quarterly invoice, we need a 20% upfront payment at contract execution (covers initial month cash flow).

If leadership (Grace) signs off on those conditions I’ll route final language and finance will record the exception.

Marcus Lin
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

Attachment: Finance_MA_Approval_Form.xlsx

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Desai <maya.desai@orwellhealth.com>, procurement@orwellhealth.com
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Proposed billing cadence for pilot + SOW — Orwell asking for quarterly net-90

Team —

I reviewed the ask and Marcus’s proposed mitigations. Approve the temporary Net-90 for the six-month pilot on the conditions Marcus listed. To recap for procurement:

- Approval: Quarterly invoice with Net-90 for pilot term only (6 months)
- Conditions: 2.0% processing fee on each invoice; Finance_MA_Approval_Form.xlsx must be signed and attached to the PO; 20% upfront payment required if Orwell chooses single invoice instead of split invoicing.
- Reversion: Terms revert to standard Net-30 at renewal unless re-approved by leadership.

Ben — please prepare the one-page approval memo for Maya to include with their purchase request and send the final SOW with the approval footnote. Marcus — please prepare the contract clause language and route for signature.

Grace O'Connor
VP, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com
